commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brentford.
90+3' Michael Kayode (Brentford) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Brentford force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
90+2' Some neat passing and movement from Brentford as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
89' 0 - 4 Goal! Fabio Carvalho (Brentford) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:4.
88' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yunus Emre Konak (Brentford) comes onto the pitch for Kevin Schade.
84' We are about to witness a subsitution. Michael Kayode (Brentford) for Kristoffer Ajer.
83' Ruud van Nistelrooy has decided to make a change. Conor Coady (Leicester) replaces Caleb Okoli.
82' Brentford hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
78' Oliver Skipp (Leicester) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Wilfred Ndidi leaves the pitch and Oliver Skipp (Leicester) comes on.
76' Leicester seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
73' Paris Maghoma (Brentford) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Vitaly Janelt.
72' Thomas Frank decides to make a substitution. Mikkel Damsgaard will be replaced by Fabio Carvalho (Brentford).
72' Great solo effort from Yoane Wissa (Brentford)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the left post.
72' Brentford fail to score from a corner as Mads Hermansen (Leicester) leaps to collect the ball.
70' Brentford failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

69' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Mads Hermansen dived superbly to block a header by Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) from around the penalty spot. His effort was directed straight towards the left post, but Mads Hermansen pulled off a remarkable save!
69' Brentford quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
67' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
65' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
63' A pass by Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
62' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
61' 5:2 – the corner kicks stats.
59' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brentford comes to nothing.
55' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) replaces Jordan Ayew.
55' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
54' Wout Faes (Leicester) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Tony Harrington blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Leicester take a short corner kick.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Christian Norgaard (Brentford) comes off for Yegor Yarmolyuk.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Woyo Coulibaly (Leicester) is replaced by Jannik Vestergaard.
46' Ruud van Nistelrooy has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Stephy Mavididi comes on the pitch for Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Leicester).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Tony Harrington due to a handball, much to the disappointment of the Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) and his team.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Caleb Okoli (Leicester) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
45' Leicester can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
44' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
44' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
42' Woyo Coulibaly (Leicester) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
38' Brentford are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
36' A corner kick by Leicester is thwarted by the well prepared Mark Flekken (Brentford).
34' Leicester take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

32' 0 - 3 It's in the back of the net! Christian Norgaard (Brentford) rises high inside the six-yard box to meet a cross by Bryan Mbeumo from the free kick. He heads home into the middle of the goal, making the score 0:3.
31' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mads Hermansen intercepts the ball.
30' A quickly taken corner by Brentford.
28' The referee cannot ignore such behaviour. Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Leicester) sees a yellow card and needs to watch himself for the rest of the game.
27' 0 - 2 Goal! Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot inside the left post.
26' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) commits a foul and Tony Harrington immediately signals a free kick.

23' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Tony Harrington with no other option than to blow for a foul.
22' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brentford, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
21' Wilfred Ndidi (Leicester) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
20' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
20' Leicester take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
19' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Mark Flekken was alert and made an astonishing save!
17' 0 - 1 Yoane Wissa (Brentford) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He produces a superb first-time shot that goes in off the left post. What a goal!
15' A pass by Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
13' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Kevin Schade (Brentford), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
11' Kevin Schade (Brentford) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
10' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
7' One of the Leicester players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
6' Victor Kristiansen (Leicester) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
5' What an amazing save by Mark Flekken! Jamie Vardy (Leicester) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the middle of the target, but fails.
3' Woyo Coulibaly (Leicester) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
2' Neat passing move from Leicester in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half has just begun.
Brentford will kick-off.
Tony Harrington will referee today's match.
